column1: # Per-notebook run-time weights used by assign_notebooks.py to balance the
# parallel notebook CI jobs (LPT bin-packing). Format: <seconds><TAB><notebook>.
# Measured via `jupyter nbconvert --to script | ipython`, same as CI runs them.
# These are rough proxies for balancing, not exact timings -- update them when a
# notebook's run time changes noticeably. Notebooks missing here get a default
